name: Exhibit
description: Builds interactive HTML exhibits the agent writes (presentations, reports, demos, visualizations), opened in a sandboxed browser tab, with versions and saved data.

display_description.en: Lets WorkSwarm build exhibits for you: interactive HTML pages, suited for presentations, reports, demos, visualizations, etc, opened in a sandboxed browser tab. Exhibits keep their versions and can save what you enter, which WorkSwarm can read back. Version 0.4.3.
display_description.zh: 让 WorkSwarm 为你制作展品：可交互的 HTML 页面，适合演示文稿、报告、演示、可视化等，并在沙盒浏览器标签页中打开。展品会保留各个版本，并能保存你填写的内容，WorkSwarm 可以读回这些内容。版本 0.4.3。

default_init_input.en: Take these raw benchmarks results and make a comprehensive presentation with charts and graphs
default_init_input.zh: 把这些原始基准测试结果做成一份包含图表的完整演示文稿

quick_inputs.en: Take these raw benchmarks results and make a comprehensive presentation with charts and graphs
quick_inputs.zh: 把这些原始基准测试结果做成一份包含图表的完整演示文稿

quick_inputs.en: Make me an interactive workout tracker
quick_inputs.zh: 帮我做一个交互式健身记录工具

quick_inputs.en: Can you explain the different ways of boarding a plane and their relative speed using some interactive diagrams
quick_inputs.zh: 能用一些交互式图示解释一下不同的登机方式以及它们各自的速度吗

display_description.en: Saves exhibits and their versions, opens them in a sandboxed browser tab and reads back what the user saved.
display_description.zh: 保存展品及其各个版本，在沙盒浏览器标签页中打开，并读回用户保存的内容。

display_description.en: Before a new exhibit is made, asks how you'd like to view it: Freeform, Slides or Document (you can change this later), or None of the above to get an answer in chat instead, unless you asked for an exhibit. It also confirms deletes and makes sure the agent has read the exhibit instructions.
display_description.zh: 在制作新展品前，询问你想以哪种方式查看：自由页面、幻灯片或文档（之后可以更改）；如果你没有明确要求展品，也可以选择“以上都不是”，直接在对话中回答。它还会确认删除操作，并确保智能体已读过展品说明。
